## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND conflict with rising credit stress (LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND; HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) → flat | NEUTRAL), producing a mixed neutral read.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit strain rising: LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND with HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) → flat | NEUTRAL. Stocks vs Bonds supportive: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND; TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-mixed: Dollar showing modest strength (Dollar Level +0.25% 1W) while TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND suggests tighter rates; SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND offsets some tightening.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Narrow leadership: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND are among four positive sectors while XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY is also up. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given 4/11 breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US slightly ahead: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND versus Europe lagging (Europe vs US ↓ falling). EM/China mixed: EEM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed speculative tone: IBIT (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +8.41%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, while ARKK (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION show short‑term pullbacks.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Mixed: CPER (1W: +1.88% | 1M: -1.58%) ↑ rising | RECOVERY and WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND show pockets of strength, while GLD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) → flat | BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND are weak.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy recovery but volatile: XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY are rallying, while UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND shows natural gas weakness.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND both showing alignment. Divergence: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (XBI, ARKK, IWM, XLV) in CORRECTION vs larger 1M gains — a material cross‑sectional divergence that tempers conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective risk exposure to sectors showing strength (XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit (LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND). Reduce exposure to clear commodity weakness (UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND) and watch speculative pockets.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Continued macro calm and falling VXX → XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND showing strength. BEARISH: If credit spreads widen further → cyclical risk (XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY) could roll over.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Crop and agricultural plays if WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND momentum continues. BEARISH: Natural gas (UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND) remains at risk.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency) with VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND; Credit spread ~0.74 (rising) with Credit Spread (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +1.07%) ↑ rising; SPY/TLT ~8.94 (stocks beating bonds) with SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF ratio 3.33 (tech vs financials) ↑ rising.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and signals are mixed between falling VXX and rising credit stress. XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength; watch credit (LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND) and multiple 1W/1M divergences (XBI, ARKK, IWM, XLV) as the key risk to conviction.
